tasks.query: set the date format the builder uses for serializing and deserializing Date values, given a pattern string or date and time style constants
tasks.note: GsonBuilder.setDateFormat has three overloads that store either a validated SimpleDateFormat pattern or date and time style constants for Date handling.

tasks.query: check whether a given type, class or type token is assignable to this one, comparing generic arguments of parameterized types and array components
tasks.note: TypeToken.isAssignableFrom (overloads for Class, Type and TypeToken) tests assignability to this token, handling parameterized and generic array types.

tasks.query: consume the non-execute prefix, a security token placed before the document, if it is present at the beginning of the input
tasks.note: JsonReader.consumeNonExecutePrefix skips leading whitespace and swallows the )]}' plus newline security prefix when it is present.

tasks.query: get the type adapter for a type, using a cache and per-thread in-progress placeholders so recursive types resolve, trying each registered factory in turn
tasks.note: Gson.getAdapter(TypeToken) returns a cached adapter or asks each factory in turn, using thread-local FutureTypeAdapter placeholders for recursive types; the Class overload delegates to it.

tasks.query: get the wrapped value as a BigInteger: return it directly if already one, convert integral numbers through long, otherwise parse the text form
tasks.note: JsonPrimitive.getAsBigInteger returns the stored BigInteger, converts integral numbers via long, or parses the string form with a length limit.

tasks.query: make an independent duplicate of an ordered list by recursively duplicating each element; an empty list just gives a fresh empty instance
tasks.note: JsonArray.deepCopy builds a new JsonArray whose elements are deep copies of this array's elements, returning an empty array when there are none.

tasks.query: start collecting deserialized property values by cloning a template array of constructor arguments in which primitive parameters already hold zero-like defaults
tasks.note: RecordAdapter.createAccumulator clones the constructor-argument defaults array (zero values for primitive parameters) that collects record component values during reading.

tasks.query: converter for classes skipped when reading or writing: discards input, emits null, lazily delegates the other direction; no converter at all when neither applies
tasks.note: Excluder.create returns null for classes that are not excluded, otherwise an adapter that skips input and writes null for the excluded direction and lazily delegates the other.

tasks.query: build a human-readable label for a field, method or constructor, quoting its declaring class and simple parameter type names, optionally capitalizing the first letter
tasks.note: ReflectionHelper.getAccessibleObjectDescription returns a quoted description such as field 'Class#name', method 'Class#name(Param)' or constructor 'Class(Param)', optionally uppercasing the first letter.

tasks.query: restore height balance in a binary search structure after an insertion or removal by walking up from the changed node applying rotations
tasks.note: LinkedTreeMap.rebalance walks from an unbalanced node to the root applying AVL rotations and updating heights after an insert or removal.

tasks.query: parse a JSON document into an element tree, rejecting trailing data, yielding JSON null for an empty document, and building nested values iteratively
tasks.note: JsonParser.parseReader checks for trailing data and wraps errors, Streams.parse maps an empty document to JsonNull, and JsonElementTypeAdapter.read builds the tree with an explicit stack.

tasks.query: block reflection-based serialization for classes denied by registered access filters: evaluating the filters in order, refusing to build field-based adapters and refusing instance creation
tasks.note: getFilterResult applies the registered filters in order, ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.create throws on BLOCK_ALL, and ConstructorConstructor.get refuses reflective or Unsafe instantiation when the result is not ALLOW.

tasks.query: serialize maps with object or array keys as a list of key-value pairs instead of a JSON object, enabled through an opt-in builder switch
tasks.note: MapTypeAdapterFactory.Adapter.write emits an array of [key, value] entries when a key serializes to an array or object in complex-key mode, which GsonBuilder.enableComplexMapKeySerialization turns on.

tasks.query: reject NaN and infinite floating-point numbers when writing: the strict adapters' validity check, and the text writer's finite-number rule that lenient mode relaxes
tasks.note: TypeAdapters.checkValidFloatingPoint throws for NaN or infinity in the strict float and double adapters, and JsonWriter.value(double) throws for them unless the writer is lenient.

tasks.query: parse a date by trying each configured format in turn, including a US pattern built from style constants, then falling back to ISO 8601 parsing
tasks.note: deserializeToDate tries each configured DateFormat and then ISO8601Utils.parse, while getUsDateTimeFormat builds the US pattern from date and time style constants.
